description: Manage hotel revenue through demand analysis, dynamic pricing, and distribution channel optimization.

steps.description: Analyze demand patterns by guest segment and booking channel.

inputs.name: historical-booking-data
inputs.desc: Past booking records with dates, segments, and channels

inputs.name: market-events-calendar
inputs.desc: Local events, holidays, and seasonal factors

outputs.name: demand-forecast
outputs.desc: Predicted demand by segment and date range

outputs.name: pattern-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of demand drivers and trends

process: Segment bookings by channel, rate code, and guest type.
Calculate occupancy trends by day of week and season.
Identify demand spikes tied to events and holidays.
Produce the demand forecast with confidence intervals.

steps.description: Set dynamic pricing rules based on demand forecast and competitive rates.

inputs.name: demand-forecast
inputs.desc: Predicted demand by segment and date

outputs.name: pricing-rules
outputs.desc: Dynamic pricing rules by room type and date

outputs.name: rate-floor-ceiling
outputs.desc: Minimum and maximum rate boundaries

process: Set rate floors based on cost-per-occupied-room.
Define ceiling rates by room type and segment.
Create rules that adjust rates based on booking pace.
Validate rules against competitive positioning.

steps.description: Manage room inventory across distribution channels (OTA, direct, GDS, wholesale).

inputs.name: channel-list
inputs.desc: Active distribution channels and their terms

outputs.name: channel-allocation
outputs.desc: Room allocation per channel per date

outputs.name: rate-parity-check
outputs.desc: Rate consistency across channels

process: Allocate rooms to each channel based on margin and volume.
Push rates to all channels maintaining parity.
Monitor channel production against allocation.
Adjust allocations based on booking pace.

steps.description: Optimize the overall rate strategy including BAR, packages, and promotions.

outputs.name: rate-strategy
outputs.desc: Finalized rate strategy with BAR and packages

outputs.name: promotion-calendar
outputs.desc: Scheduled promotions and their terms

process: Set the best available rate (BAR) ladder by room type.
Design value-add packages for low-demand periods.
Schedule promotions aligned to need periods.
Document the strategy with rationale for each decision.

steps.description: Monitor RevPAR, occupancy, and ADR against budget and forecast.

inputs.name: actual-performance-data
inputs.desc: Daily revenue, occupancy, and ADR actuals

outputs.name: performance-dashboard
outputs.desc: RevPAR, occupancy, and ADR vs budget

outputs.name: revenue-management-report
outputs.desc: Final revenue management report with recommendations

process: Calculate daily RevPAR, ADR, and occupancy.
Compare actuals against budget and forecast.
Identify underperforming segments and dates.
Recommend strategy adjustments for the next period.

description: Manage restaurant inventory from par levels through ordering, receiving, and cost analysis.

steps.description: Set par levels for each ingredient based on usage history and lead time.

inputs.name: ingredient-list
inputs.desc: All ingredients used in the menu

outputs.name: par-levels
outputs.desc: Par level for each ingredient

outputs.name: reorder-points
outputs.desc: Reorder trigger points by ingredient

process: Calculate average daily usage for each ingredient.
Factor in supplier lead times and delivery schedules.
Set par levels with a safety stock buffer.
Define the reorder point for each item.

steps.description: Track daily ingredient usage and waste to identify variance.

inputs.name: daily-production-log
inputs.desc: What was prepared and served each day

outputs.name: usage-report
outputs.desc: Daily usage by ingredient vs expected

outputs.name: waste-log
outputs.desc: Waste by category (spoilage, over-prep, plate waste)

process: Record actual usage per ingredient per shift.
Log all waste by category and cause.
Compare actual usage against theoretical usage.
Flag items with variance above threshold.

steps.description: Generate purchase orders based on par levels and current inventory.

outputs.name: purchase-orders
outputs.desc: Generated purchase orders by supplier

outputs.name: order-schedule
outputs.desc: Delivery schedule by supplier

process: Compare current inventory against par levels.
Generate orders for items at or below reorder point.
Consolidate orders by supplier for efficiency.
Schedule deliveries to match storage capacity.

steps.description: Receive and inspect deliveries against purchase orders.

inputs.name: delivery-documents
inputs.desc: Invoices and packing slips from deliveries

outputs.name: receiving-log
outputs.desc: Accepted items with quantities and conditions

outputs.name: discrepancy-report
outputs.desc: Short shipments, quality issues, and substitutions

process: Check delivered quantities against the purchase order.
Inspect quality (temperature, freshness, packaging).
Log discrepancies and notify the supplier.
Update inventory counts with accepted items.

steps.description: Conduct and reconcile weekly physical inventory counts.

outputs.name: count-reconciliation
outputs.desc: Physical vs book inventory comparison

outputs.name: inventory-variance
outputs.desc: Variance by item with possible causes

process: Count every item in storage by weight or unit.
Compare physical count against the book inventory.
Identify and investigate significant variances.
Adjust the book inventory to match the count.

steps.description: Analyze food cost percentage and trends.

outputs.name: food-cost-report
outputs.desc: Food cost percentage by category and trend

outputs.name: inventory-management-report
outputs.desc: Final inventory management report with action items

process: Calculate food cost percentage (cost of goods / revenue).
Break down cost by menu category.
Identify the top contributors to variance.
Recommend actions to reduce waste and cost.

description: Plan and execute catering for an event from initial brief through service.

steps.description: Gather the event details including guest count, dietary needs, budget, and theme.

outputs.name: event-requirements
outputs.desc: Structured requirements (count, dietary, theme, timing)

outputs.name: budget-allocation
outputs.desc: Budget split across food, beverage, staff, and rentals

process: Confirm guest count and dietary restrictions.
Define the event timeline and service style.
Allocate the budget across categories.
Document special requests and non-negotiables.

steps.description: Design the menu to match the event requirements and budget.

outputs.name: proposed-menu
outputs.desc: Menu with items, portions, and pricing

outputs.name: dietary-accommodation-plan
outputs.desc: Plan for each dietary restriction

process: Select menu items that fit the theme and budget.
Design options for each dietary restriction.
Calculate the per-person cost.
Produce the menu proposal for client review.

steps.description: Calculate ingredient quantities based on the menu and guest count.

outputs.name: ingredient-list
outputs.desc: Itemized ingredient quantities needed

outputs.name: procurement-timeline
outputs.desc: When each ingredient must be ordered and delivered

process: Scale each recipe to the guest count with waste factor.
List all ingredients with quantities and units.
Identify items needing advance ordering.
Build the procurement timeline.

steps.description: Plan the kitchen production timeline for the event.

outputs.name: production-schedule
outputs.desc: Time-sequenced kitchen prep and cooking plan

outputs.name: equipment-needs
outputs.desc: Equipment and space requirements

process: Map each menu item to its prep and cook time.
Sequence tasks to optimize kitchen workflow.
Identify equipment and staging needs.
Build the hour-by-hour production schedule.

steps.description: Coordinate service staff for the event.

outputs.name: staffing-plan
outputs.desc: Staff assignments with roles and timing

outputs.name: catering-plan
outputs.desc: Final catering plan combining menu, timeline, and staff

process: Calculate the server-to-guest ratio by service style.
Assign staff to stations and roles.
Schedule arrival, briefing, and breakdown times.
Produce the final catering plan.

description: Design the end-to-end guest experience from pre-arrival through post-stay.

steps.description: Map the guest journey across all touchpoints.

inputs.name: target-guest-profile
inputs.desc: Primary guest segments and their expectations

outputs.name: journey-map
outputs.desc: Guest journey map with all touchpoints by phase

outputs.name: pain-points
outputs.desc: Current friction points in the guest experience

process: Define journey phases (pre-arrival, arrival, stay, departure, post-stay).
List every touchpoint within each phase.
Identify the current pain points at each touchpoint.
Map emotional highs and lows across the journey.

steps.description: Define the service standard for each touchpoint in the guest journey.

outputs.name: service-standards
outputs.desc: Defined standard for each touchpoint

outputs.name: measurement-criteria
outputs.desc: How to measure compliance with each standard

process: Write the expected behavior for each touchpoint.
Define the timing standard (check-in under 3 minutes, etc.).
Set the measurement method for each standard.
Prioritize standards by guest impact.

steps.description: Design recovery protocols for service failures.

outputs.name: recovery-protocols
outputs.desc: Recovery protocol for each failure scenario

outputs.name: empowerment-guidelines
outputs.desc: What staff can do without manager approval

process: List the most common service failure scenarios.
Design a recovery response for each scenario.
Define the authority level for each recovery action.
Set the compensation guidelines (upgrade, comp, discount).

steps.description: Build the training plan to embed the service standards.

outputs.name: training-plan
outputs.desc: Training program by role and topic

outputs.name: certification-criteria
outputs.desc: How staff demonstrate competency

process: Group standards and protocols by staff role.
Design training modules for each group.
Set the certification criteria for each role.
Schedule the training rollout.

steps.description: Measure guest satisfaction and produce the experience report.

outputs.name: satisfaction-scorecard
outputs.desc: Guest satisfaction scores by touchpoint

outputs.name: guest-experience-plan
outputs.desc: Final guest experience plan with improvement priorities

process: Select the survey instruments (post-stay, in-stay, review sites).
Collect and aggregate satisfaction data.
Score each touchpoint against the standard.
Identify the top improvement priorities.

description: Schedule and manage housekeeping operations for a hotel property.

steps.description: Forecast room turnover by day to plan housekeeping labor.

inputs.name: reservation-data
inputs.desc: Current reservations with check-in and check-out dates

outputs.name: turnover-forecast
outputs.desc: Expected departures, stayovers, and arrivals by day

outputs.name: labor-hours-needed
outputs.desc: Estimated labor hours by day

process: Count departures, stayovers, and arrivals per day.
Apply the cleaning time standard per room type and status.
Calculate total labor hours needed per day.
Identify peak days requiring extra staff.

steps.description: Assign rooms to housekeeping attendants based on workload.

outputs.name: room-assignments
outputs.desc: Rooms assigned to each attendant

outputs.name: daily-schedule
outputs.desc: Shift schedule with start times and breaks

process: Distribute rooms evenly by credit (departure rooms count more).
Group assignments by floor or section to minimize travel.
Schedule shifts to match the arrival pattern.
Post the assignments before each shift.

steps.description: Define cleaning standards and the inspection protocol.

outputs.name: cleaning-checklist
outputs.desc: Room cleaning checklist by room type

outputs.name: inspection-rate
outputs.desc: Target inspection rate and method

process: Define the cleaning checklist for each room type.
Set the inspection sampling rate (percentage of rooms).
Define the scoring criteria for inspections.
Document the process for failed inspections.

steps.description: Track room turnaround time and handle exceptions.

outputs.name: turnaround-metrics
outputs.desc: Average turnaround time by room type and attendant

outputs.name: housekeeping-schedule
outputs.desc: Final housekeeping schedule with metrics and exceptions handled

process: Log the start and end time for each room.
Calculate average turnaround by room type.
Track rush requests and late checkouts.
Produce the daily performance report.

description: Control food costs by comparing theoretical vs actual cost and implementing variance reduction.

steps.description: Calculate the theoretical food cost for each menu item.

inputs.name: current-ingredient-prices
inputs.desc: Current purchase prices for all ingredients

outputs.name: theoretical-cost-by-item
outputs.desc: Cost per menu item based on recipe and price

outputs.name: menu-margin-analysis
outputs.desc: Margin analysis for each menu item

process: Cost each ingredient in each recipe at current prices.
Calculate the total cost per portion.
Compare cost against the selling price for margin.
Flag items below the target margin.

steps.description: Compare actual food cost against theoretical to identify variance.

inputs.name: actual-food-cost-data
inputs.desc: Actual purchases, inventory changes, and revenue

outputs.name: cost-variance
outputs.desc: Variance between actual and theoretical cost

outputs.name: variance-by-category
outputs.desc: Variance broken down by food category

process: Calculate actual food cost from purchases and inventory.
Compute the variance from theoretical.
Break variance down by category.
Rank categories by variance size.

steps.description: Investigate the sources of food cost variance.

outputs.name: root-causes
outputs.desc: Identified causes of variance (waste, portioning, theft, pricing)

outputs.name: control-recommendations
outputs.desc: Recommended controls for each cause

process: Analyze waste logs for spoilage and over-production.
Audit portion sizes against recipe standards.
Review purchasing prices against contracted rates.
Assess shrinkage patterns for potential theft.

steps.description: Implement controls to reduce food cost variance.

outputs.name: control-plan
outputs.desc: Controls implemented with responsible parties

outputs.name: food-cost-report
outputs.desc: Final food cost report with variance, causes, and controls

process: Deploy standardized recipes with portioning tools.
Set up regular inventory counts.
Implement purchase order approval controls.
Schedule weekly food cost reviews.

description: Plan and execute banquet operations from event order through breakdown.

steps.description: Process the banquet event order and extract operational requirements.

inputs.name: event-order
inputs.desc: Signed event order with menu, setup, AV, and timing

inputs.name: venue-specifications
inputs.desc: Room dimensions, capacity, and equipment available

outputs.name: operational-requirements
outputs.desc: Extracted setup, menu, staff, and AV requirements

outputs.name: event-timeline
outputs.desc: Minute-by-minute event timeline

process: Parse the event order for all service requirements.
Map the timeline from setup through breakdown.
Identify any requirements not covered by in-house resources.
Confirm all details with the event planner.

steps.description: Plan the room setup including layout, AV, and decor.

outputs.name: setup-diagram
outputs.desc: Room layout diagram with table placement and AV

outputs.name: setup-checklist
outputs.desc: Checklist of all items to set up

process: Design the room layout to meet the event order.
Specify table, chair, linen, and place setting counts.
Map AV equipment placement and power needs.
Create the setup checklist with responsible parties.

steps.description: Schedule banquet staff by role and shift.

outputs.name: banquet-staffing-plan
outputs.desc: Staff schedule with names, roles, and times

outputs.name: briefing-notes
outputs.desc: Pre-service briefing notes for the team

process: Calculate staff needed by role (servers, bartenders, runners).
Assign staff based on skill and availability.
Write the pre-service briefing notes.
Schedule the setup and breakdown crews.

steps.description: Coordinate the menu execution with the kitchen for the banquet.

outputs.name: kitchen-production-plan
outputs.desc: Course-by-course production plan with fire times

outputs.name: banquet-operations-record
outputs.desc: Final banquet operations record

process: Translate the menu into a production plan with quantities.
Set fire times for each course.
Coordinate with the service team on pacing.
Document the complete operations record.

description: Set up and manage a hotel preventive maintenance program.

steps.description: Inventory all building systems and equipment requiring maintenance.

outputs.name: asset-registry
outputs.desc: Complete list of maintainable assets with location and age

outputs.name: criticality-ranking
outputs.desc: Assets ranked by impact of failure

process: Walk every area and list all maintainable equipment.
Record make, model, serial, age, and location for each.
Rank each asset by the impact of its failure on operations.
Organize the registry by system (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, elevator, FF&E).

steps.description: Define maintenance tasks and frequencies for each asset.

outputs.name: task-library
outputs.desc: Maintenance tasks with frequencies and procedures

outputs.name: annual-schedule
outputs.desc: 12-month maintenance calendar

process: Define the PM tasks for each asset type from manufacturer specs.
Set the frequency based on criticality and usage.
Estimate labor and material for each task.
Build the annual schedule distributing work evenly.

steps.description: Schedule and track maintenance work orders.

outputs.name: active-work-orders
outputs.desc: Current open work orders with status

outputs.name: completion-metrics
outputs.desc: PM completion rate and overdue count

process: Generate work orders from the annual schedule.
Assign work orders to technicians by skill.
Track completion and close work orders.
Report PM completion rate weekly.

steps.description: Manage guest-reported maintenance issues.

outputs.name: issue-resolution-log
outputs.desc: Guest issues logged with resolution times

outputs.name: maintenance-program-report
outputs.desc: Final maintenance program report with metrics and recommendations

process: Log each guest-reported issue with priority.
Dispatch the appropriate technician.
Track resolution time against the SLA.
Produce the monthly maintenance report.

description: Analyze and optimize a restaurant menu by classifying items on popularity and profitability.

steps.description: Classify each menu item by popularity (sales mix) and profitability (contribution margin).

inputs.name: sales-mix-data
inputs.desc: Number sold per item over the analysis period

inputs.name: item-cost-data
inputs.desc: Food cost and selling price per item

outputs.name: item-classification
outputs.desc: Each item classified as star, plow horse, puzzle, or dog

outputs.name: contribution-margins
outputs.desc: Contribution margin for each item

process: Calculate the contribution margin for each item.
Calculate the menu mix percentage for each item.
Plot items on the popularity vs profitability matrix.
Classify each item (star, plow horse, puzzle, dog).

steps.description: Assess the current menu layout and its effect on item sales.

inputs.name: current-menu-layout
inputs.desc: Current menu design and item placement

outputs.name: layout-findings
outputs.desc: Which items get prime placement vs their classification

outputs.name: placement-recommendations
outputs.desc: Where to place each item for better results

process: Map item placement against the eye-tracking zones.
Compare placement with item classification.
Identify mismatches (dogs in prime spots, stars hidden).
Recommend placement changes.

steps.description: Recommend actions for each menu item (promote, reprice, reformulate, or remove).

outputs.name: action-plan
outputs.desc: Recommended action for each item

outputs.name: projected-impact
outputs.desc: Projected revenue and margin impact of changes

process: Stars: maintain quality, keep prominent placement.
Plow horses: increase price carefully or reduce cost.
Puzzles: reposition on menu, add descriptions, or rebrand.
Dogs: remove, replace, or reformulate.

steps.description: Redesign the menu and test with a pilot period.

outputs.name: new-menu-design
outputs.desc: Redesigned menu layout

outputs.name: menu-engineering-report
outputs.desc: Final menu engineering report with classification, actions, and test results

process: Apply the placement and pricing changes to the menu design.
Run the new menu for a test period.
Compare sales mix and margins against the prior period.
Produce the final report with before-and-after data.

description: Standardize front desk operations from check-in through payment processing.

steps.description: Define the standard check-in and check-out procedures.

inputs.name: property-type
inputs.desc: Type of property and its PMS system

inputs.name: service-level
inputs.desc: Target service level and brand standards

outputs.name: check-in-procedure
outputs.desc: Step-by-step check-in procedure

outputs.name: check-out-procedure
outputs.desc: Step-by-step check-out procedure

process: Write the check-in steps from greeting through key issuance.
Write the check-out steps from folio review through departure.
Include the express and mobile check-in alternatives.
Set the time target for each procedure.

steps.description: Set up the reservation management workflow.

outputs.name: reservation-workflow
outputs.desc: Reservation handling from booking through arrival

outputs.name: overbooking-policy
outputs.desc: Overbooking thresholds and walk procedures

process: Define the reservation confirmation and pre-arrival communication.
Set the overbooking threshold by room type.
Write the walk procedure for overbooked guests.
Document the cancellation and no-show policies.

steps.description: Handle guest requests and complaints at the front desk.

outputs.name: request-handling-guide
outputs.desc: Standard responses for common requests

outputs.name: complaint-escalation-matrix
outputs.desc: When and how to escalate complaints

process: Catalog the most common guest requests and their standard responses.
Define the escalation path for complaints by severity.
Set the resolution authority at each level.
Document the logging requirement for each interaction.

steps.description: Process payments and manage guest folios.

outputs.name: payment-procedures
outputs.desc: Payment processing procedures by method

outputs.name: front-desk-operations-manual
outputs.desc: Complete front desk operations manual

process: Document the payment methods accepted and their processing steps.
Define the folio management rules (posting, adjustments, splits).
Set the end-of-shift balancing procedure.
Compile all procedures into the front desk operations manual.
